subject: general
question: The first livestock census in India was conducted during:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1919-1920.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Livestock Census in India**

__
 
• The Livestock Census **covers all domesticated animals and its headcounts**.
 
• **19 censuses** have been conducted in participation** with State Governments and UT Administrations.**
 
• The** 20th Livestock Census** was conducted in participation with all **States and Union Territories**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan** has the highest number of Sheep in India.
 
• **Brazil** has the largest cattle inventory in the world followed by India and China.
 
• **West Bengal** had the highest cattle population across India, at about 19 million in 2019.
